parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ='{{ $json.drive_folder_id }}' in parents and mimeType='application/pdf' and (name contains 'stub' or name contains 'Stub' or name contains 'payroll' or name contains 'Payroll')

meta.description: Reads the newest pay stub PDFs the team manually uploaded to the client's Drive folder and has Claude extract YTD withholdings. No payroll system connections — per DATA-GOVERNANCE. Returns ctx + payroll.
